summary: Diagnose malformed remediation collections and require timezone-qualified timestamps

delivery.outcome: Return structured rejection for malformed remediation collection fields and non-object source without exceptions. Require a full timezone-qualified source timestamp. Preserve exact raw input, scoped paths, existing valid plans and advisory authority; publish immutable standard 0.20.72.
nonGoals: Change execution or protected publication authority
Change field identities or introduce dependencies/bundled remediation module
Normalize invalid raw paths into accepted scope
Mutate foreign or frozen target state

architecture.decision: After existing structural validation, use private copied collection records of shape-safe entries for cross-field checks; keep all recorded errors and exact original document/digest untouched. Align source timestamp parsing to the existing date-time schema with explicit zone and full time. Reuse the actual READY fixture and CLI regressions.
interfaceChanges: Existing malformed-input validation emits structured errors instead of crashing, and requires date-time with explicit timezone.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Malformed collections/source regressions reproduce crashes; invalid date-only/naive timestamps reproduce acceptance. Structured errors, CLI behavior, original-input immutability, valid offsets and raw scope are checked.
Existing integrations, parity, wheel, native and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev checks pass.
Independent protected merge and immutable v0.20.72 release are verified.
